intent.raw: Integrate the pasted response from another session into the current FormalClaim/FOL design.
intent.objective: Reconcile the external response with the validated @1 candidate, narrow unsupported claims, and materialize a fresh @2 run-local successor without changing @1, frozen @4, canonical, product, or owner-admission bytes.

technique_overlays.trigger: A second-session synthesis contains compatible claims, duplicated design, one semantic-field conflict, and new cross-capability integration details.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every external claim is classified; only evidence-backed compatible deltas enter @2; executable_profile remains outside source meaning; capability state is labeled; @1, @4, EVF, TDE, DS-SFOL, Craft, Inventory, Git, and authority surfaces remain unchanged.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Repository AGENTS.md requires one native background helper for non-trivial bounded Invoke authoring and validation.
subagent_strategy.explanation: One Invoke Refresh helper can perform the exact evidence comparison, stage and validate a fresh successor, and return a receipt while the parent retains scope, review, and final claims.
context: The validated @1 Define/Design candidate already contains most of the external response.
The new useful residue is the DS-SFOL authority migration rule and the FormalClaim-to-EVF/factory/evidence integration seam.
The external executable_profile field conflicts with the established meaning/capability split and must not be copied into FormalClaim source meaning.
No owner admission, implementation, migration apply, provider registration, solver execution, promotion, or publication is authorized.

roles.purpose: Build strict context, classify the external response, author and materialize a fresh @2 successor inside the refresh run, validate the exact material and Design boundaries, and return one helper receipt.
roles.owns: Only fresh run-local context, reconciliation, material-package, successor, validation, report, and helper-receipt artifacts below the declared run root.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: integrate this response from another session

steps.name: Build strict cross-session context and validate Inventory lookup

inputs.ref: pasted cross-session response plus validated @1 and directly cited repository evidence

stop_conditions: stop if a material claim lacks exact source evidence or is contradicted without a recorded resolution
stop if Inventory lookup readiness is blocked

steps.name: Classify and reconcile every external proposal
stop_conditions: stop if executable_profile is placed in source meaning
stop if all formal logics are collapsed into FOL
stop if designed or planned integrations are described as implemented

steps.name: Stage, validate, and apply the exact run-local @2 successor

inputs.ref: direct user integration request approving only the exact fresh run-local successor target inventory

stop_conditions: stop unless normalized approval scope, material targets, and target inventory are exact-set equal
stop unless staged bytes validate before apply
stop on any write outside the fresh run root

steps.name: Validate successor boundaries and return the helper receipt
stop_conditions: stop on stale source digests, invalid JSON, path or symlink defects, trailing whitespace, capability-state inflation, unexecuted-witness inflation, or authority inflation

gates.condition: Every integrated claim is backed by selector-level evidence or explicitly labeled synthesis/inference.
FormalClaim source meaning remains separate from executable profiles, assessments, provider outcomes, evidence, and discharge.
The exact create-only successor target set equals approval and material targets, validates before apply, and is byte-equal after apply.
The helper returns one complete receipt and the parent independently verifies scope and result before final claims.

boundaries.contract: Write only the fresh run-local allowlist, preserve parent-authored dispatch and briefing, and return one receipt.

boundaries.to_owner: proof bridge, TDE, EVF, factory, provider, evidence, and lifecycle owners
boundaries.contract: FormalClaim owns exact statement meaning; all downstream contracts remain digest-bound projections or evidence and do not self-discharge or promote.

authority.lifecycle: Invoke Refresh authoring and fresh successor materialization only
authority.promotion: separate exact owner and verifier gates

state_namespaces.write_policy: only enumerated paths in the fresh run; all source, prior candidates, product, authority, public, telemetry, and Git surfaces remain read-only

promotion_splits.target: owner acceptance, verifier admission, canonical ontology, migration, implementation, execution, proof, discharge, promotion, publication, release, deployment, or production
promotion_splits.rule: No transition occurs without separately owned exact-byte acceptance and downstream lifecycle receipts.

observability.signal_grouping: run-local dispatch_id and step_id; no telemetry append authorized

promotion_guardrails: FormalClaim is the canonical home of the exact formal statement and logic-profile reference, not a claim that every formal logic is FOL.
Executable profile and decidability fields belong to the validation-owned assessment, never source meaning.
The DS-SFOL body.logic transition is a proposed migration rule, not an applied migration.
EVF/factory/SMT/proof-provider integrations must be labeled current, designed, planned, or absent accurately.
No owner admission, canonical mutation, product implementation, solver execution, proof, discharge, promotion, publication, release, deployment, or production effect is authorized.
